method: Portable official binary downloaded and release API digest matched, single fixed-source rule downloaded. No installer/PATH/service/account change. findings: All eight main runs exit0 with empty stderr; exit success is not zero-alert proof. Inspect JSON.
Regular/irregular passive1 each, active manual revision0; adverb/get0; adjectival state1; progressive0; indeed1 false positive.
Rule is existence-based be + immediate participle, same broad heuristic family as write-good; shared behavior is not independent accuracy evidence. It does not include passive-voice indeed exclusion.
JSON includes matched words and message; output capture/storage is an explicit text data path. No automatic rewrite or replacement suggestions in observed alerts.

Local runtime behavior is demonstrated, but no comprehensive source dependency, network/diagnostic/retention audit was conducted. --no-global limits global config loading; not a network block or all-host-state guarantee.
privacyGaps: Selected CLI code paths and libraries have not been reviewed for operational text transmission/diagnostics.
No observed or documented complete text-retention/deletion boundary for this chosen CLI invocation.
Binary/source equivalence not established; release digest confirms artifact identity, not behavior or isolation.
decision: Useful local configurable passive-review workflow with explicit threshold and false-positive limits; research-only and not privacy qualified. Same-rule variants must not fill minimum candidate counts.
next: Assess selected CLI text-data paths against route rubric before qualification; do not substitute hosted CMS sequence-rule examples for this existence rule. No new owner packet capture requested.
